header: The import takes minutes (the OCR), and a database connection held open all that time can be dropped by the network (it was, once: "read ETIMEDOUT", an unhandled error event, and the whole run died with a stack trace). So I use the database in SHORT steps: connect, do one thing, disconnect, and if a step fails because the connection broke, do that step again on a new connection. A connection that breaks while idle can no longer crash the program: I swallow its error (it matters only if the step in progress needs it, and that step then fails and is retried).

symbols.name: withConnection
